module.name: Busbar Org Create
module.blurb: Create a Salesforce scratch org or sandbox for CI.
module.longDescription: Provisions an ephemeral Salesforce environment for a CI run — scratch org or sandbox — and exposes its alias and instance URL to downstream steps.

inputs.name: org-name
inputs.label: Org name
inputs.description: Name for the new scratch org.

inputs.name: admin-email
inputs.label: Admin email
inputs.description: Admin email for the scratch org.

inputs.name: snapshot
inputs.label: Snapshot (optional)
inputs.description: Snapshot name or id to create the org from (create-from-snapshot).

inputs.name: duration-days
inputs.label: Duration (days)
inputs.description: How long the scratch org lives (1-30).

inputs.name: source-id
inputs.label: Source ID
inputs.description: Source org ID for cloning (only for sandboxes).

inputs.name: first-name
inputs.label: First Name
inputs.description: Admin First Name (only for trial orgs).

inputs.name: last-name
inputs.label: Last Name
inputs.description: Admin Last Name (only for trial orgs).
